title: 第7章 杨婵拜师孔宣天凤真羽第8章 小姨子龙吉
slug: 杨戬你爹从朝歌城考编回来了
content_zh:
;;
瑶姬做好了早餐，说是去镇上买一些菜回来，杨易也没有多想。
杨婵今天休沐，不用去上学，杨易也估摸着带着杨婵去孔宣面前认认门。
凡间的学堂教的都是一些陈芝麻烂谷子的东西，哪里有跟着准圣大能进步快。
而且杨婵天生有修炼的天赋，不像是杨易，杨易曾经跟闻仲讨要一些截教修行的神通，然而闻仲只是给了杨易一些呼吸吐纳长生的法门。
闻仲查看了他的根基，坦白的告诉杨易他不是修行的料子，就算理论知识再牛逼，肉身条件达不到也是瞎扯淡。
不过杨易也有自己的打算，谁说修行就要脚踏实地一步步的修上去？
如今杨易身负人间气运，更是掌握天下文脉，一身文道气运如日中天，这就是杨易现在的根基，未来这些文道气运总有变现的时候。
孔宣就在杨易家不远处搭了一个庐蓬，只要他不嫌弃，杨易自然是没话说。
杨婵看着神秘兮兮的杨易，问道：“阿爹，你带我来这么偏僻的地方做什么？你不会趁着阿娘不在家，把婵儿给卖了吧。”
杨易白了杨婵一眼，道：“你可是爹的心头肉，对了，镇上的猪肉多少文一斤？”
这一下轮到杨婵无语了。
爷俩就这么谈笑风生来到了这庐蓬之外，这个时候孔宣走了出来。
“老爷。”
孔宣微微拱手。
杨易瞥了一眼，道：“都说了不在朝中不用如此拘束，你就是这么死板。”
杨易将杨婵带到了孔宣的面前，杨婵看了一眼，道：“好威武的大哥哥。”
杨易点了点头，道：“婵儿，跪下，请了那三跪九叩的大礼，从今天起这位孔宣便是你的师父了。”
“要这么严肃吗？”
“严肃一点好。”

杨易认真的说道，孔宣也并没有拒绝，三跪九叩是依天地之礼，他肯受了这大礼，也是诚心上收了这么一个弟子。
“弟子杨婵，拜见孔宣老师。”
杨婵恭恭敬敬的在泥泞的地面上伏跪而下，也不嫌弃，直勾勾的朝着孔宣拜去。
直到请了这大礼之后，孔宣亲自将杨婵扶了起来，然而杨婵却发现，自己身上竟然一点泥巴都没有沾。
“阿爹，你看我身上没有沾染任何泥巴，好神奇啊。”
杨婵左看看，右看看，直呼不可思议。
“哈哈哈哈！”
杨易笑道：“这便是你这孔宣老师的厉害之处。”
孔宣摸了摸杨婵的头，然后朝着眉心一点，一缕五彩幻光显化而出，在他手中化为一道翎羽。
“婵儿，这是我母亲在我未曾化形之时留下的天凤真羽，今日为师将此物赠与你防身，别说是这小小的泥尘，就算是天塌下来，也伤不了你分毫。”
杨婵接过了这羽毛，她虽然不理解孔宣说的意思，但这天凤真羽她显然十分喜欢。

Yao Ji made breakfast and said she was going to the town to buy some vegetables. Yang Yi didn't think much about it.
Yang Chan had a break today and didn't have to go to school. Yang Yi also thought about taking Yang Chan to recognize him in front of Kong Xuan.
All the schools in the world teach are useless things. How can one make rapid progress by following the quasi-sage?
Moreover, Yang Chan was born with a talent for cultivation, unlike Yang Yi. Yang Yi once asked Wen Zhong for some magical powers to practice Jie Jiao, but Wen Zhong only gave Yang Yi some methods of breathing and breathing for immortality.
Wen Zhong checked his foundation and told Yang Yi frankly that he was not the material for cultivation. No matter how good his theoretical knowledge was, it was still nonsense if he could not meet the physical conditions.
But Yang Yi also has his own plans. Who said that cultivation requires down-to-earth practice step by step?
Nowadays, Yang Yi has destiny in the world, and he has mastered the world's context. His destiny in literature is at its peak. This is Yang Yi's current foundation. There will always be a time when these destiny in literature will be realized in the future.
Kong Xuan built a tent not far from Yang Yi's house. As long as he didn't dislike it, Yang Yi would naturally have nothing to say.
Yang Chan looked at the mysterious Yang Yi and asked, "Dad, why did you bring me to such a remote place? You wouldn't sell Chan'er while my mother was not at home, right?"
Yang Yi rolled his eyes at Yang Chan and said, "You are my father's favorite. By the way, how much is a pound of pork in this town?"
This time it was Yang Chan's turn to be speechless.
The two men were talking and laughing like this when they arrived outside the hut. At this time, Kong Xuan came out.
"Master."
Kong Xuan slightly arched his hands.
Yang Yi glanced at me and said, "I told you that you don't have to be so restrained when you're not in court. You're just so rigid."
Yang Yi brought Yang Chan to Kong Xuan. Yang Chan took a look and said, "What a mighty big brother."
Yang Yi nodded and said: "Chan'er, kneel down and ask for the great gift of kneeling three times and kowtowing nine times. From today on, Kong Xuan will be your master."
"Are you going to be so serious?"
"It's better to be serious."
Yang Yi said seriously, and Kong Xuan did not refuse. Kneeling three times and prostrating nine times was a gift from heaven and earth. He was willing to accept this gift and sincerely accepted such a disciple.
"Disciple Yang Chan, meet with Teacher Kong Xuan."
Yang Chan knelt down respectfully on the muddy ground, and went straight to worship Kong Xuan without disdain.
After receiving this great gift, Kong Xuan personally helped Yang Chan up. However, Yang Chan found that there was no mud at all on her body.
"Dad, look, there's no mud on me. It's amazing."
Yang Chan looked left and right, exclaiming that it was incredible.
"Hahahaha!"
Yang Yi smiled and said: "This is the power of your teacher Kong Xuan."
Kong Xuan touched Yang Chan's head, then moved it toward the center of his eyebrows, and a ray of colorful phantom light appeared, turning into a feather in his hand.
"Chan'er, this is the true feather of the Heavenly Phoenix that my mother left behind when I was still in my incarnation. Today, I will give this to you for self-defense. Not to mention this little dust, even if the sky falls, it won't be able to hurt you at all."
Yang Chan took the feather. Although she didn't understand what Kong Xuan meant, she obviously liked Feng Zhenyu very much.
